usedFor: StoreHippo holds the shop's orders and users, and Conversion Chats sends a template message after “New User Enquiry”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User Enquiry” in StoreHippo, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: An enquiry gets its answer as a template message, sent through your Conversion Chats account.

watchOut: A message to a shopper leaves the business, so “Send Template Message” waits in Needs you until someone approves it.
